overall: The AG found the Marlborough City Council violated the Open Meeting Law by letting a quorum deliberate during a posted Finance Committee meeting without posting its own notice. No remedial order was issued; the letter serves as guidance.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged a quorum of the 11-member council deliberated during a posted Finance Committee meeting without the full council posting notice or convening.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Council violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to post notice for and convene a meeting during the May 16, 2011 Finance Committee meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant argued that subcommittees rarely allow public participation, so councilors speaking from the audience would force public comment at subcommittee meetings.
allegations.key_passage: Whether to allow public participation, and to what extent, is a matter at the discretion of the chair.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
